audience: parcel senders and dispatch teams that ship with InPost in Poland

useCases.title: Check the shipments of a day and their status
useCases.text: List the shipments created on a given day, filtered by status if needed. Use the status codes list to explain each status to the team.

useCases.title: Track a parcel and read its history
useCases.text: Enter a tracking number to see the current status, locker details and status history, newest first. Tracking data is available for 45 days after a shipment is created.

useCases.title: Review courier pickups booked for shipments
useCases.text: List the dispatch orders of the organisation, then open one to read its details.

useCases.title: Confirm which organisations a token can access
useCases.text: List the organisations this token can access, then read one organisation to find its id and details.
